name: BPTP Downtown 66
summary: Project, developer (BPTP Limited), Sector 66 location, RERA number GGM/981/713/2025/84, under-construction status, starting price (~Rs 5.0-5.6 Cr on portals), 3 towers / 504 units / 46 floors and ~4.23 acres are all confirmed. Minor issues: land area is 4.235 acres per RERA-quoting sources (we say 4.25), Square Yards lists 592 units instead of 504, and we omit the possession date (October 2032 per RERA) and the 3/4 BHK configurations.

checks.web: BPTP Downtown 66 / Downtown-66, newly launched high-rise residential project in Sector 66, Gurugram

checks.note: Reports also mention a Rs 488 crore construction contract awarded by BPTP to NCC Limited for this project.

checks.ours: Sector 66, Golf Course Extn Rd, Sector 66, Gurugram, Haryana
checks.web: Sector 66, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurugram, Haryana
GGM/981/713/2025/84 (Square Yards); RERA tracker lists application/project id RERA-GRG-2009-2025
checks.note: RERA-GRG-2009-2025 is the HARERA project/application id, not a conflicting registration number.
We do not publish a possession date; sources agree on October 2032, which could be added.

checks.web: Rs 5.00 Cr entry (RERA tracker, at Rs 20,000/sq ft); Rs 5.59 Cr for 3 BHK 2,600 sq ft (Square Yards, Rs 21,500/sq ft)
3 BHK ~2,500-2,900 sq ft and 4 BHK ~2,900-3,400 sq ft (super area; sources differ)
checks.note: We publish no configurations; RERA tracker says 3 BHK ~2,500 / 4 BHK ~2,900 sq ft, Square Yards says 3 BHK 2,600/2,900 and 4 BHK 3,400 sq ft.

checks.web: 4.235 acres (17,138.44 sq m) per RERA tracker; 4.23 acres per Square Yards (within a 14.518-acre licensed parcel)
checks.note: Rounding difference only; 4.24 would be the accurate rounding of 4.235.

checks.web: 3 towers, 504 units, 46 floors (RERA tracker); Square Yards says 3 towers and 592 homes
checks.note: Sources disagree on unit count (504 vs 592); the RERA-based figure matches ours.
